title: 3.28.0j Patch Notes
all_changes: PoE 1 Sony servers are undergoing maintenance. Some features will be unavailable.
3.28.0j Patch Notes
3.28.0j Patch Notes
Return of the Ancestors
Added support for the Return of the Ancestors league event.
Added Silver Coins and all Trial of the Ancestors exclusive Tattoos to the Currency Exchange.
Silver Coins and Forbidden Tattoos will be deleted at the end of the Return of the Ancestors event.

Winning Trial of the Ancestor Tournaments can offer a new type of Tattoo that applies to Ascendancy Notables. These Tattoos will grant Notables from all the base game Ascendancies (not the Phrecian Ascendancies).
If you have the following Phrecian Ascendancy Notables allocated, then these Ascendancy Tattoo notables will be disabled due to functionally stacking in a bad way:
Blind Prophet's Sightless and Slayer's Overwhelm
Daughter of Oshabi's Innate Blessing and Guardian's Harmony of Purpose
Paladin's Light of Divinity and Inquisitor's Augury of Penitence
Paladin's Elemental Valiance and Guardian's Radiant Crusade
Paladin's Anointed Champion and Inquisitor's Pious Path
Ascendancy Tattoos cannot apply to multiple choice notables, Bloodline Ascendancy notables or notables that grant Passive Points (such as Aristocrat's Inherited Fortune).
You can no longer enter Trials of the Ancestors at Ranking 130 or higher if you have not killed Kitava in Act 5.
Match reward chests in the Trial of the Ancestors will also reward some Gold.
For the Return of the Ancestors event Lost Karui Shipments and Shipping to Karui Ports will reward Runegrafts instead of Tattoos.
Kingsmarch overview screen will now estimate the duration of map device jobs based on all remaining maps being completed at 100%, instead of just the next map.
Talisman of the Victor can now be converted to a Microtransaction using the /convertracereward chat command.
Fixed a longstanding bug where Leap Slam could get the player stuck in terrain.
Fixed a visual bug when using the Divine Ice Crown MTX and Ghoul Character Effect MTX together.
Fixed a bug where Kosis, the Revelation would never use their Orb Detonation skill while Taunted.
Fixed a bug where Iron Will Support would show as supporting some Attack skills like Chain Hook and Explosive Arrow.
Fixed a bug where the Tracking Scroll of Peddling was missing its 2D art.
Fixed a bug where certain Map Devices would not react properly when an NPC opens a portal for you in your Hideout.
Fixed a bug where the Grand Curator of Wisdom Body Armour was not removed correctly on the Witch, Scion, and Duelist.
Fixed a client crash with Holy Strike.
Fixed a client crash with the Flicker Strike Afterimage MTX.
Fixed a client crash with the Chaosborn Body Armour MTX.
Fixed 2 buffer underflow client crashes.
Fixed a client crash on PS5.
Fixed an instance crash.
